description: 固定名义年利率房贷试算，支持等额本息(annuity)、等额本金(principal)与对比(both) / Fixed-rate mortgage calculator (annuity vs equal-principal). Pass annualRate in percent (e.g. 3.5 for 3.5%). Example: {"principal": 1000000, "months": 360, "annualRate": 3.5}.

annualRate.description: 固定年利率百分数（如 3.5 表示 3.5%，非 0.035，范围 0–30）/ Annual rate in %, e.g. 3.5

includeSchedule.description: 是否返回分页明细（默认 false）/ Include paginated schedule (default false)

mode.description: 还款方式 / Repayment mode: both (default) | annuity | principal

months.description: 贷款期限（整月，1–600，如 30 年填 360）/ Loan term in months (1-600), e.g. 360

principal.description: 贷款本金（人民币元，0 < P <= 100000000）/ Loan principal in CNY, e.g. 1000000

scheduleLimit.description: 明细返回期数上限（1–24）/ Max schedule rows (1-24, default 12)

scheduleStart.description: 明细起始期数（从 1 开始）/ Start month index (default 1)

name: calculate_mortgage
title: 房贷还款试算（妙用盒）
